outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding in the first 5 months
cohort: Children born in the last 24 months (n=6351) and children aged 0-5 months (n=1619) from the 2015-16 Malawi Demographic and Health Survey
finding: Healthcare providers and programs should consider factors associated with early initiation of breastfeeding and exclusive breastfeeding, such as delivery method, birth location, and child's age, to improve these practices in Malawi.
